notes.title: Multiplayer Update is here!
notes.content:
Big day for FLS, multiplayer, new building blocks, engine update and a ton of quality of life improvements throughout.

- Multiplayer lobbies, server functionality and gameplay implemented
- Unreal Engine 5 Upgrade
- New types of building blocks added
- New map browser
- More visual feedback while flying with camera movement and particles
- Map auto downloading
- Added skin customization options to the ship and trails as paid purchases
- Improved and more responsive map search
- More reliable leaderboards instantly displayed per map
- Updated UI visuals and layout
- Removed download map achievement due to it being fully automated, Removed Pink Me Achievement due to requests of it being too hard to complete, 
- Editor ring placement bugfixes
- Updated level editor

notes.title: 1.2 Update
notes.content:
Hey!

The new update on the maps browser is now out!

[b]You can now preview maps, browse the workshop directly from the game itself[/b] and [b]search all the maps available online[/b] without opening the workshop. 

A [b]full-screen toggle[/b] was also added to the settings.

Additionally, now there's [b]more music[/b]! Various tracks change depending on whether you are in the menus or in a map playing.

New Icon browser buttons were also added, where you can also show only the page containing the newly added maps to the workshop.

Flying through rings is also less flashy right now with the brightness of the rings decreasing as you get close for a nicer experience.

I hope you like it!

Thanks!

notes.title: 1.11 Update
notes.content:
Hey!

As achievements are getting unlocked fast, now we will have some more of them!

Here are some of the new achievements in this update:
[list]
[*]Beginner Pilot (Gain ranks and total score to unlock Level 5)
[*]Intermediate Pilot (Gain ranks and total score to unlock Level 10)
[*]Advanced Pilot (Gain ranks and total score to unlock Level 20)
[*]Master Pilot (Gain ranks and total score to unlock Level 30)
[*]Expert Pilot (Gain ranks and total score to unlock Level 40)
[*]Unbeatable Pilot (Gain ranks and total score to unlock Level 50)
[*]Augmented Super Pilot (Gain ranks and total score to unlock Level 75)
[*]Best of the best (Gain ranks and total score to unlock Level 100)
[*]Trying to Pink it (Have "Pink me" as your Most Played Map)
[*]Pinked it (Complete "Pink me" map)
[*]Checking out maps (Play 10 different maps)
[*]Map Master (Play 100 different maps)
[*]Just passed a few rings (Reach 10k Total Score Gained)
[*]Ok maybe more than a few rings passed (Reach 100k Total Score Gained)
[*]Let's make it harder (Create a new Map of Medium Difficulty)
[*]I said Let's make it Harder (Create a new map of Hard Difficulty)
[*]I SAID HARDER! (Create a new map Of Very Hard Difficulty)
[*]I don't need no Mouse (Pass a Map without using the Mouse)
[*]Engines Off (Pass a Map without using Thrust)
[/list]

As a little side improvement, you can now see the difficulty of the level while you are creating it, as well as at the time you are taking the thumbnail. 

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.content:
1.1 Update is here

Hey guys! 
As the game progressed further there were a few changes made to improve the experience.

Changes:
[list]
[*]There is a new help menu button! It will include a few different things:
[olist]
[*]Common questions explaining the game for anyone that wants to learn more
[*]Explanations for achieving score, levels and ranks
[*]Help using the editor
[/olist]
[*]A new button to download a random map if you don't feel like browsing the workshop! This should automatically find the maps you have and look for a new map that does not currently exist locally
[*]From now on submitting a map to the workshop will require you to complete your new level. This will prevent impossible to complete levels from being uploaded
[*]The thumbnail generator will automatically calculate the center of the map and the distance required to fit the majority of the level into the thumbnail, you will still be able to rotate it around into any angle that you prefer the level to be displayed from
[*]A short intro animation! Instead of a black screen when opening the game, you will now see a short animation
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*]Fix for a way to submit a score from a different map to the one you are playing. This required precise timing and fast switching, but will no longer be possible
[*]Loading screens not displaying while syncing workshop subscriptions
[/list]

Thanks for your support!
